The scheduler crashes since the sort in assign() was changed to plan the
shifts in week order. Ana works Monday to Friday and is trained for the bar,
so she can obviously take the Friday bar shift; the old sort never had this
problem. I think the new sort key in assign() drops her.

    team = [worker("ana", "mon-fri", "bar,floor"), worker("ben", "sat,sun", "bar")]
    assign(team, [Shift("fri", "bar"), Shift("sat", "bar")])
